question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The girl tried to __alleviate__ her brother’s problem.
solution:
The correct answer is: **reduce**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"alleviate"** means to make something less severe or intense; to relieve or reduce. (कम करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She took painkillers to alleviate her headache.
 
 
 
• **"Reduce"** refers to making something smaller or less in amount, degree, or size. (घटाना)
 
 
• **Example: **We need to reduce our expenses to save more money.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that a synonym for **'alleviate'** is **'reduce'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **reduce**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Worsen** (बिगाड़ना): To make something worse or more severe.

 
 
• **Example:** His comments only served to worsen the situation.
 
 
 
• **Soar** (ऊंची उड़ान भरना): To fly or rise high in the air; to increase rapidly.
 
 
• **Example: **The eagle soared high above the mountains.
 
 
 
• **Increase** (बढ़ाना): To become or make greater in size, amount, or degree.
 
 
• **Example:** We need to increase our efforts to achieve our goals.
